user_query: I'm a researcher studying global time zones. Can you provide me with a list of time zones, including their zone names, time zone names, GMT offsets, and abbreviations? Also, include the countries associated with each time zone.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of all global time zones including zone names, GMT offsets, and abbreviations.
For each time zone retrieved in Step 1, gather associated countries and any relevant details.
